ce0f5f31.text: People often say the internet was built so it could survive a nuclear attack. That story is half right, and the half that's wrong is the interesting half. Pick an answer.

6bec7457.text: Here's what having no center did, on the one hand and on the other. What it made easy: there's no switchboard to seize, no headquarters to raid, and no single machine whose failure stops the network. Damage routes around itself, whether the damage is a broken cable or a government. A country can block its own connections to the outside, and has to keep doing it, machine by machine, forever. What it made hard: there's also nobody in charge. No one can be required to check that traffic is safe, remove something harmful, or take responsibility when the network carries an attack. Nobody can switch off a flood of malicious traffic centrally, because there's no center at which to switch it off.
6bec7457.spoken: Here's what having no center did, on the one hand and on the other. What it made easy: there's no switchboard to seize, no headquarters to raid, and no single machine whose failure stops the network. What it made hard: there's also nobody in charge. No one can be required to check that traffic is safe, remove something harmful, or take responsibility when the network carries an attack. Nobody can switch off a flood of malicious traffic centrally, because there's no center at which to switch it off.

ff9c58a9.text: Once packets worked, a harder question arrived. How clever should the network itself be?

a4333f16.text: The telephone companies had an answer. Put the intelligence in the network, and sell services from it.

0eb98388.text: On that model, a new kind of communication needs the network's owner to build it and agree to it.

c21564b7.text: The internet's designers chose the opposite. In 1981, Jerome Saltzer, David Reed, and David Clark wrote down why.
c21564b7.spoken: The internet's designers chose the opposite. In 1981, Jerome Saltzer, David Reed, and David Clark wrote down why.

d37ac672.text: The rule is called the end-to-end principle. The network moves packets and does nothing else. Everything clever happens on the machines at the two ends.
d37ac672.spoken: The rule is called the end-to-end principle. The network moves packets and does nothing else. Everything clever happens on the machines at the two ends.

c74d629b.text: The network doesn't know whether a packet is part of an email, a film, or a game.
c74d629b.spoken: The network doesn't know whether a packet is part of an email, a film, or a game.

6f62991c.text: It wasn't built to know, and the design says it shouldn't need to.
6f62991c.spoken: It wasn't built to know, and the design says it shouldn't need to.

0a705061.text: So inventing a new kind of thing to do online needs nobody's permission, and no change to the wiring.
0a705061.spoken: So inventing a new kind of thing to do online needs nobody's permission, and no change to the wiring.

5fb544e7.text: Almost everything you use exists because of this one decision.

293d75d8.spoken: The web, streaming video, online games, and messaging were all added by people who never asked a network owner.

6b80bf61.text: That's called permissionless innovation, and it's rare. Most industries don't work this way.
6b80bf61.spoken: That's called permissionless innovation, and it's rare. Most industries don't work this way.

c64f9065.text: The cost is that the basic design treats urgent and trivial traffic alike, because it wasn't built to tell them apart.
c64f9065.spoken: The cost is that the basic design treats urgent and trivial traffic alike, because it wasn't built to tell them apart.

5b33c84c.spoken: None of that required a new invention. It's the shopping basket fix, used as written.

a7301180.text: Watching people is what makes advertising valuable, and advertising is why the web is free.
a7301180.spoken: Watching people is what makes advertising valuable, and advertising is why the web is free.

22c36f44.text: A cookie is data, not a program. Nothing new had to be invented to follow people between sites. A company whose code sits on thousands of sites simply uses the basket mechanism exactly as it was written.
22c36f44.spoken: A cookie is data, not a program. Nothing new had to be invented to follow people between sites. A company whose code sits on thousands of sites simply uses the basket mechanism exactly as it was written.

e48714e0.text: There was never a vote on paying for the web with attention instead of money. It was settled by a few companies finding out what worked.
e48714e0.spoken: There was never a vote on paying for the web with attention instead of money. It was settled by a few companies finding out what worked.

725748f9.text: Charging money for pages was tried repeatedly in the 1990s, and mostly failed.
725748f9.spoken: Charging money for pages was tried repeatedly in the 1990s, and mostly failed.

f8be7a3b.text: Advertising didn't fail, so it became the default, and then it became the assumption.
f8be7a3b.spoken: Advertising didn't fail, so it became the default, and then it became the assumption.

db442377.text: The result is that most things online are free, and that being measured is the ordinary condition of using them.
db442377.spoken: The result is that most things online are free, and that being measured is the ordinary condition of using them.

ec63fa66.text: The legal scholar Lawrence Lessig gave this whole pattern a name. Software, he argued, regulates what people can do in the same way that law does. Here's how he put it in 1999. In real space, we recognize how laws regulate, through constitutions, statutes, and other legal codes. In cyberspace, we must understand how code regulates, how the software and hardware that make cyberspace what it is regulate cyberspace as it is.
ec63fa66.spoken: The legal scholar Lawrence Lessig gave this whole pattern a name. Software, he argued, regulates what people can do in the same way that law does. Here's how he put it in 1999. In cyberspace, we must understand how code regulates, how the software and hardware that make cyberspace what it is regulate cyberspace as it is.

8acdbeb5.text: A rule enforced by software needs no police, no court, and no vote. It simply isn't possible to break.
8acdbeb5.spoken: A rule enforced by software needs no police, no court, and no vote. It simply isn't possible to break.

9ff21ab8.text: The first six were decided by people who wrote down what they were doing. Nobody decided this one. Look at the two pictures. Nothing in the protocol changed between them.
9ff21ab8.spoken: The first six were decided by people who wrote down what they were doing. Nobody decided this one. Look at the two pictures. Nothing in the protocol changed between them.

86579c71.text: Packets still route around damage, and no router has ever been given a center.
86579c71.spoken: Packets still route around damage, and no router has ever been given a center.

fa389b01.text: Almost everything you do online now starts or ends at one of a few companies.
fa389b01.spoken: Almost everything you do online now starts or ends at one of a few companies.

c14cded0.text: Nobody ordered this either. Several ordinary pressures happened to push the same way at once.
c14cded0.spoken: Nobody ordered this either. Several ordinary pressures happened to push the same way at once.

ce5165d2.text: A place is more useful the more people are already there, so whatever leads tends to keep leading.
ce5165d2.spoken: A place is more useful the more people are already there, so whatever leads tends to keep leading.

51df3a79.text: Advertising pays far more for one large audience than for many small ones.
51df3a79.spoken: Advertising pays far more for one large audience than for many small ones.

d501a187.text: Hosting, moderation, and surviving attacks all cost more than a small site can carry alone.
d501a187.spoken: Hosting, moderation, and surviving attacks all cost more than a small site can carry alone.

0a5fe468.text: gnome-gazette.example now gets most of its readers from somebody else's feed, rather than from people typing its name.
0a5fe468.spoken: gnome-gazette.example now gets most of its readers from somebody else's feed, rather than from people typing its name.

50650539.text: A language model is one more thing built on top, the way the web was built on top of the wiring. It changes what the layer underneath is for.
50650539.spoken: A language model is one more thing built on top, the way the web was built on top of the wiring. It changes what the layer underneath is for.

b4ee73af.text: The web ran on links. You were sent somewhere, and the somewhere was paid for by your arriving.
b4ee73af.spoken: The web ran on links. You were sent somewhere, and the somewhere was paid for by your arriving.

25210147.text: A model answers you where you stand. In a 2025 Pew study, Google users shown an AI summary clicked through to a result about half as often.
25210147.spoken: A model answers you where you stand. In a 2025 Pew study, Google users shown an AI summary clicked through to a result about half as often.

3a117f04.text: It learned to answer by reading pages whose authors were never asked.
3a117f04.spoken: It learned to answer by reading pages whose authors were never asked.

f8c4b7e9.text: That's the asymmetry from 1989 again. A link needs the sender's permission, and never the receiver's.
f8c4b7e9.spoken: That's the asymmetry from 1989 again. A link needs the sender's permission, and never the receiver's.

8f17205e.text: This one isn't graded. Pick the answer closest to your view, and read its note. It's being argued in courts right now, and it isn't settled. An assistant reads gnome-gazette.example, then answers your question without sending you there. What is that?

c1a673de.spoken: The web ended up concentrated in a few companies. Check every cause the lesson gives, then press Check answers.

ca5e12bd.text: Nothing in the protocol changed. The concentration came from ordinary pressures, not from a new center.
ca5e12bd.spoken: Nothing in the protocol changed. The concentration came from ordinary pressures, not from a new center.

404d5114.text: Open rules meant anyone could join in without permission. Names needed a top, and a top is a place that can be leaned on. And the web costs nothing because somebody else is paying for your attention.
404d5114.spoken: Open rules meant anyone could join in without permission. Names needed a top, and a top is a place that can be leaned on. And the web costs nothing because somebody else is paying for your attention.

b3fdf335.text: Six decisions made on purpose, a seventh that nobody made at all, and every one of them now a rule the rest of us live inside.
b3fdf335.spoken: Six decisions made on purpose, a seventh that nobody made at all, and every one of them now a rule the rest of us live inside.

d6b77316.text: Values into design. Survivability, thrift, academic openness, physics filing, and shop baskets each left a permanent mark on the shape of the thing.
d6b77316.spoken: Values into design. Survivability, thrift, academic openness, physics filing, and shop baskets each left a permanent mark on the shape of the thing.

9ae5ebe1.text: Design into values. No center made censorship hard, a dumb network made permission unnecessary, names made a chokepoint, and a basket fix made surveillance ordinary.
9ae5ebe1.spoken: Design into values. No center made censorship hard, a dumb network made permission unnecessary, names made a chokepoint, and a basket fix made surveillance ordinary.

98aadfb2.text: And a shape nobody chose. The wiring still has no center. What people actually use has three or four.
98aadfb2.spoken: And a shape nobody chose. The wiring still has no center. What people actually use has three or four.

ab744400.text: None of these was a decision about how anyone should live, and all of them turned into one.
ab744400.spoken: None of these was a decision about how anyone should live, and all of them turned into one.
